changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Asset') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Asset]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [ParentID] bigint null, [Level] int constraint DF_Asset_Level default(1) not null, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Asset_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [Path] xml constraint DF_Asset_Path default('<path />') not null, [DisplayValue] nvarchar(850) null, DisplayPath as dbo.GetDisplayPath([Path],' > ',' / ') PERSISTED, KeyPath as dbo.GetKeyPath([Path]) PERSISTED, [Object] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Asset_ObjectId] DEFAULT (NEXT VALUE FOR [dbo].[Asset_ObjectID_Seq]) NOT NULL, [SourceID] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [KeyHash] [varchar](50) NULL, [FieldHash] [varchar](50) NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Asset_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [Code] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [Color] [varchar](19) NULL, [Icon] [varchar](50) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Asset] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ), CONSTRAINT [UC_Asset_Object_ObjectID] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) ) END GO
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Asset_AssetType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Asset] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Asset_AssetType] FOREIGN KEY([AssetTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AssetType] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Asset] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Asset_AssetType] END GO
if not exists (select 1 from information_schema.[columns] where table_Schema= 'dbo' and table_name = 'Asset' and column_name = 'DisplayValue') begin alter table dbo.Asset add DisplayValue nvarchar(850) null; end GO
if not exists (select 1 from information_schema.[columns] where table_Schema= 'dbo' and table_name = 'Asset' and column_name = 'ParentID') begin alter table dbo.Asset add ParentID bigint null end GO
if not exists (select 1 from information_schema.[columns] where table_Schema= 'dbo' and table_name = 'Asset' and column_name = 'Level') begin alter table dbo.Asset add [Level] int constraint DF_Asset_Level default(1) not null end GO
if not exists (select 1 from information_schema.[columns] where table_Schema= 'dbo' and table_name = 'Asset' and column_name = 'Path') begin alter table dbo.Asset add [Path] xml constraint DF_Asset_Path default('<path />') not null; end GO
if not exists (select 1 from information_schema.[columns] where table_Schema= 'dbo' and table_name = 'Asset' and column_name = 'DisplayValue') begin alter table dbo.Asset add DisplayValue nvarchar(850) null; end GO
if not exists (select 1 from information_schema.[columns] where table_Schema= 'dbo' and table_name = 'Asset' and column_name = 'DisplayPath') begin alter table dbo.Asset add DisplayPath as dbo.GetDisplayPath([Path],' > ',' / ') PERSISTED; end GO
if not exists (select 1 from information_schema.[columns] where table_Schema= 'dbo' and table_name = 'Asset' and column_name = 'KeyPath') begin alter table dbo.Asset add KeyPath as dbo.GetKeyPath([Path]) PERSISTED; end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_Asset') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from [sys].[foreign_keys] WHERE name = 'FK_AssetPath_Asset') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetPath] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetPath_Asset]; END IF EXISTS (select * from [sys].[foreign_keys] WHERE name = 'FK_AssetDataProfile_Asset') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfile] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetDataProfile_Asset]; END IF EXISTS (select * from [sys].[foreign_keys] WHERE name = 'FK_AssetProcessDiagram_AssetID') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetProcessDiagram] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetProcessDiagram_AssetID]; END IF EXISTS (select * from [sys].[foreign_keys] WHERE name = 'FK_ASSETTAG_ASSET') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTag] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_ASSETTAG_ASSET]; END
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Asset] DROP CONSTRAINT [PK_Asset] DROP INDEX [CIX_Asset] ON [dbo].[Asset] ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Asset] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_Asset] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC )
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [sys].[foreign_keys] WHERE name = 'FK_AssetPath_Asset') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetPath] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetPath_Asset] FOREIGN KEY([ID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Asset] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetPath] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetPath_Asset] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [sys].[foreign_keys] WHERE name = 'FK_AssetDataProfile_Asset') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfile] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetDataProfile_Asset] FOREIGN KEY([AssetID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Asset] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfile] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetDataProfile_Asset] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [sys].[foreign_keys] WHERE name = 'FK_AssetProcessDiagram_AssetID') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetProcessDiagram] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetProcessDiagram_AssetID] FOREIGN KEY([AssetID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Asset] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetProcessDiagram] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetProcessDiagram_AssetID] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_ASSETTAG_ASSET') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTag] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_ASSETTAG_ASSET] FOREIGN KEY([AssetID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Asset] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTag] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_ASSETTAG_ASSET] END END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_AssetType_Include') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Asset_AssetType_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_AssetType_KeyHash_Include') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Asset_AssetType_KeyHash_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_AssetTypeID_Include') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Asset_AssetTypeID_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_AssetTypeID_SourceID') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Asset_AssetTypeID_SourceID] ON [dbo].[Asset] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_Object_Include') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Asset_Object_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_Object_ObjectID_Include') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Asset_Object_ObjectID_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_ObjectID_Include') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Asset_ObjectID_Include] ON [dbo].[Asset] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_SourceID_Object_ObjectID') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Asset_SourceID_Object_ObjectID] ON [dbo].[Asset] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_State_AssetTypeID') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Asset_State_AssetTypeID] ON [dbo].[Asset] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_uid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_uid] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [uid] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_AssetTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Asset_AssetTypeID] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [AssetTypeID] ASC ) include([State],[SourceID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_DisplayValue') BEGIN create nonclustered index [IX_Asset_DisplayValue] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [DisplayValue] ASC ) include([AssetTypeID],[Uid],[State]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_DisplayPath') BEGIN create nonclustered index [IX_Asset_DisplayPath] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [DisplayPath] ASC ) include([AssetTypeID],[Uid],[State]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Asset_KeyPath') BEGIN create nonclustered index [IX_Asset_KeyPath] ON [dbo].[Asset] ( [KeyPath] ASC ) include([AssetTypeID],[Uid],[State]) END
-- clean dupe SourceID before applying unique index below. update T set T.SourceID = null from Asset T inner join ( select AssetTypeID, SourceID, min(ID) as MinID from Asset where SourceID is not null group by AssetTypeID, SourceID having count(1) > 1 ) S on S.AssetTypeID = T.AssetTypeID and S.SourceID = T.SourceID and t.ID > s.MinID;
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'UQ_Asset_SourceID') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UQ_Asset_SourceID ON dbo.Asset(AssetTypeID, SourceID) where SourceID is not null; END

changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from [sys].[fulltext_indexes] i inner join [sys].[objects] o on o.object_id = i.object_id and o.Name = 'Asset' ) BEGIN CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ON dbo.Asset(DisplayValue) KEY INDEX PK_Asset ON fullTextCatalog END
